Instantly, in the emptiness of the landscape, a cry arose whose shrillness pierced the still

And as if by enchantment, streams of human beings, of naked human beings, with spears
in their hands, with bows, with shields, with wild glances and savage movements, were poured
into the clearing by the dark-faced and pensive forest.
